characters.name: Ravi
characters.look: Slim Indian boy, messy black hair, brown eyes, white school shirt with rolled sleeves, grey trousers, a red thread bracelet.

characters.name: Ira
characters.personality: Sharp, stubborn, generous once she trusts you.
characters.look: Indian girl, long black braid, dark eyes, yellow kurta over jeans, paint-stained fingers, a kite-string reel clipped to her belt.

characters.name: Mr. D'Souza
characters.look: Old Goan man, white stubble, round glasses, faded blue shirt, leather apron with pliers in the pocket.
characters.voice: Slow, a proverb in every second line.

locations.name: School roof
locations.description: Flat concrete school rooftop with blue water tanks, washing lines and a low wall; the sea beyond.
locations.ambience: Sea wind, distant traffic and a school bell.

locations.name: D'Souza Repairs
locations.description: Cramped repair shop: shelves of spools, bamboo strips, radios, a workbench under a hanging bulb.
locations.ambience: Ticking clock, a fan, the street outside.

locations.name: Festival beach
locations.description: Wide grey-sand beach with fishing boats pulled up, festival flags and hundreds of kites in the sky.
locations.ambience: Waves, wind in flags, a crowd.
